name: Triplet Boost
description: Triplets/Kongs: +50 Fu and +0.5 Han

flavor_spans.text: "Three of a kind? Heh!? a powerful omen indeed!" - Voice in the crowd.

name: Sequence Surge
description: Sequences score an additional +50 Fu and +1.25 Han

flavor_spans.text: Power surges through your tiles! You are kind of afraid to touch them now, You didn't even know these were conductive.

name: Pair Power
description: Pairs score an additional +45 Fu and +1.25 Han

flavor_spans.text: Alone we are formidable, but together we are unstoppable!

name: Honor Fury
description: Honor tiles in melds score an additional +42 Fu

flavor_spans.text: A quiet rumor follows Honor Fury wherever it rests.

name: Dragon Rage
description: Cashing in a dragon triplet/kong: +8 Han

flavor_spans.text: The house has crossed the Dragon; His rage will carry you to a most deserved victory.

name: Green Luck
description: Chamber cleared: +¥4 yen if no honors were scored

flavor_spans.text: The luck of the Irish!

name: Kindling
description: Cashing in a structure: +{{kindling_mult}} Han from {{kindling_cashins}} cash-ins (max +{{kindling_cap}} Han)

flavor_spans.text: Every hand thrown feeds the fire. By the end, it roars.

name: White Dragon's Hush
description: White dragon pairs score an additional +6 Han and grant a random Zodiac

flavor_spans.text: The White Dragon's Hush is a silence so palpable it pushes every emotion from the room save two: Fear, and Reverence.

name: Blue Tiles White Dragon
description: Cashing in a structure with a pinzu meld and a white dragon meld: +6 Han

flavor_spans.text: Blue tiles laid in a row, a blank dragon watching — the old players say this pairing opens the gate.

name: Green Tiles Green Dragon
description: Cashing in a structure with a souzu meld and a green dragon meld: +6 Han

flavor_spans.text: Bamboo stalks and a green dragon crest — the pairing the old bamboo cutters swear by.

name: Red Tiles Red Dragon
description: Cashing in a structure with a manzu meld and a red dragon meld: +6 Han

flavor_spans.text: Crimson characters and a red dragon seal — fortune favors the hand that holds both.

name: Joker Tile
description: Chamber entered: create a permanent copy of a random tile in your hand

flavor_spans.text: What is both the sage and the idiot?

name: Strength in Numbers
description: The wall contains 6 copies per tile instead of 4

flavor_spans.text: Your tiles form a mighty phalanx, like the  shell of a beetle!

name: Quick Draw
description: Draw +2 tiles after each play

flavor_spans.text: "You're twitchin mister, look mighty antsy to put them tiles down. Why don't you do that? That is, if you think your draw is quick enough." - Doc'hao Li Dei.

name: Chain Reaction
description: +6 Han if you already cashed in this round

flavor_spans.text: With ever link in the chain , the power of your tiles grow.

name: Multiplier Master
description: +{{multiplier_master_mult}} Han (+1.5 Han per relic held)

flavor_spans.text: Rumors carry across the air that you might just be the next Multiplier Master, could it be true?

name: Set Magnet
description: Drawing a 3rd copy of a tile draws a 4th from the wall, if one exists

flavor_spans.text: "This relic has a strange aura about it. Tiles are drawn to it, but only in certain orders. How peculiar." - Sagacious Zhou

name: Wild Winds
description: Wind tiles can substitute in sequences

flavor_spans.text: "The winds wage war on one another since time immemorial, the ghosts of summers and springs passed that charge screaming over the waves and lay siege to the shore. Will they fight for you?" -Toad

name: Dragon Echo
description: Cashing in a structure: retrigger dragon melds

flavor_spans.text: The roar has passed but its
power
still rings out from the mountain to the sea.

name: Kan Drum
description: Cashing in a structure with at least one kong: +1 play and +8 Han

flavor_spans.text: The drum beats guide your feet, the rhythm moves your hands even though not a hand plays it.

name: Dora Crown
description: There are now two dora tiles; Dora tiles score an additional +50 Fu

flavor_spans.text: Old players swear by the
Dora
— never the tile, always the tale.

name: Windreader
description: There are now two round winds; round wind triplets/kongs: +9 Han

flavor_spans.text: The readers gaze never settles in one direction for very long.

name: Eight Treasures
description: Cashing in a complete hand (4 melds + pair) grants a random Zodiac

flavor_spans.text: A chest marked clearly in auspicious symbols, every translation the same. "Good fortune smiles upon the holder of the Eight Treasures!"

name: Kong's Blessing
description: Kongs score an additional +180 Fu and +3 Han

flavor_spans.text: Old players swear by the
Kong's
— never the tile, always the tale.

name: Garden Keeper
description: Flower tiles score an additional +40 Fu

flavor_spans.text: "The Green Thumb's karma is surely paying off this evening!" —
Member of the cheering crowd

name: Ikebana
description: Cashing in a structure with 2+ flowers: +9 Han

flavor_spans.text: "When you give life to the flowers, they give you something in return. Oh how I love my flowers." - Lady Blossom.

name: Hanami
description: +¥3 yen per cashed-in flower tile

flavor_spans.text: "What a strange thing! to be alive beneath cherry blossoms."
Kobayashi issa

name: Jade Serpent
description: Souzu tiles score an additional +12 Fu

flavor_spans.text: Bringer of The Monsoon, Carry to me your favor, over mountain and hill, through thicket and thistle! Carry to me your favor!
- Prayer chalked onto the pot of a withered Bonsai

name: Ruby Serpent
description: Manzu tiles score an additional +12 Fu

flavor_spans.text: "Serpent of Wealth and Honor, bringer of prosperity! Please, I don't have much coin left. My child is sick let me win and I shall make a shrine for you, and burn incense every day of my life!" - Half burnt petition

name: Lapis Serpent
description: Pinzu tiles score an additional +12 Fu

flavor_spans.text: Serpent of Truth and Wisdom, show me now! Show me what is to be my fate! I must know!
- Plea laboriously carved into one of the play tables.

name: Low Tide
description: Tiles ranked 1-3 score an additional +10 Fu

flavor_spans.text: Mud, Silt and the ever present stench of decay let you know, every. single. day.

name: High Tide
description: Tiles ranked 7-9 score an additional +10 Fu

flavor_spans.text: The rising tide lifts all ships!
- Mortal proverb

name: Even Keel
description: Tiles ranked 4-6 score an additional +12 Fu

flavor_spans.text: Between the mud and the crest, the calm middle pays steady.

name: Plain Dealing
description: Simple tiles (rank 2-8) in melds score an additional +18 Fu

flavor_spans.text: No dragons, no winds, no fuss — just honest tiles and honest score.

name: Merchant's Eye
description: 25% discount on shop prices

flavor_spans.text: The eye bounces happily amidst the small pile of coin you set down, then it rolls off the counter out of sight. Strange times ahead.

name: I Got A Guy
description: The next {{restocks_left}} shop restocks are free

flavor_spans.text: They say he can Do anything, Be anyone. He's willing to lend you a hand.

name: Edge Runner
description: Terminals score an additional +18 Fu

flavor_spans.text: Let prudent souls bemoan spent gold. The universe rewards the
free and bold.

name: Lucky Seven
description: Rank-7 tiles in scored sets: +1.5 Han each (max +9 Han)

flavor_spans.text: Those other plays? not so lucky. This time? this time is different!

name: Momentum
description: +2 Han per play already used this round

flavor_spans.text: "Man, this thing really goes once you get the ball rolling!" - An excited gambler

name: Minimalist
description: Cashing in a one-meld structure: +120 Fu and +2 Han

flavor_spans.text: You have always managed to get by with very little, and this should be no different.

name: Turtle Shell
description: Cashing in a structure: +300 Fu; destroyed if yen hits 0

flavor_spans.text:
Loba was wise, and ancient beyond reasoning. Now this relic is all that remembers her.
Use it while it lasts, all things fade.

name: Closed Gate
description: Structure is exclusively terminals and honors: +6 Han

flavor_spans.text: "A closed gate , the path of opportunity remains unbarred"-
The Tanuki

name: Open Gate
description: Structure is exclusively simple tiles (rank 2-8): +6 Han

flavor_spans.text: The gate stands open to walkers whose tiles never stray from the middle road.

name: Chow Line
description: Cashing in a structure with 3+ sequences: +4 Han

flavor_spans.text: Three chows in a row — the table learns your rhythm and pays it back.

name: Golden Engine
description: +{{golden_mult}} Han from ¥{{gold_held}} held (+1 Han per 3 yen, max +12 Han)

flavor_spans.text: Before you sits the Alchemist's magnum opus, whirring and shaking as it accomplishes the impossible"
- An excerpt from "
Tales of the Not Believed!

name: Snowball
description: +{{snowball_chips}} Fu from {{snowball_stacks}}/{{snowball_cap}} cleared chambers (+25 Fu per clear)

flavor_spans.text: At first it wasn't that big of a deal. BUT NOW! IT'S OUT OF CONTROL!

name: Second Wind
description: The first time you would lose a blind, destroy this relic and forfeit that blind with no payout (other relics still apply)

flavor_spans.text: "This tile has gotten me out of more close calls then I care to remember."
- Toad

name: Glass Cannon
description: Cashing in a structure: +12 Han; destroyed after activation

flavor_spans.text: Sometimes power is more fragile than anyone imagines.

name: Last Breath
description: Cashing in a structure with 0 plays left: retrigger all melds in the structure

flavor_spans.text: This one is cold. It makes you feel lonely. You want to discard, but you can't.

name: Tile Polisher
description: Cashed in tiles gain a permanent, stacking +5 chip bonus

flavor_spans.text: You can rub out just about anything, any smudge or streak even your sins.

name: Paper Lantern
description: +4 Han; 1-in-{{ff_paper_destroy}} chance to be destroyed at round end

flavor_spans.text: Handcrafted and full of light, the lights of The Shop guide you to more than victory.

name: Stone Lantern
description: ×3.0 final Han; 1-in-{{ff_stone_destroy}} chance to be destroyed at round end

flavor_spans.text: What paper promised in a night,
stone
keeps in the garden ever after.

name: Mirror Tile
description: Copies the effect of the next relic

flavor_spans.text: When you look into the mirror all you see is your weary face, but you feel it. It see you.

name: Way of Purity
description: Structure is all one suit: +6 Han

flavor_spans.text: The way is open to the walker whose innocence guides them along the path purity.

name: Geese
description: Cashing in a structure: retrigger the first 5 melds

flavor_spans.text: What do geese know of chevrons?

name: Voice of the People
description: Cashing in a structure: retrigger melds of tiles ranked 1-4

flavor_spans.text: Ones worth is greater than can be summed up by numbers alone, The people united though small outnumber all.

name: Voice of the Elite
description: Cashing in a structure: retrigger melds of tiles ranked 6-9

flavor_spans.text: The quiet murmurs of  bureaucrats and traders fill the room the second you touch this one,  You want in on the deal?

name: XXXL Egg
description: Cashing in a structure: retrigger all melds. {{egg_charges}} charges left (destroyed at 0)

flavor_spans.text: Now that's a
big
egg! What could have laid a thing like that?!

name: Tea Ceremony
description: Activates four separate bonuses in turn (Harmony, Respect, Purity, Tranquility). Next: {{tea_next}}, {{tea_hands_left}} hands left. Destroyed after the fourth activation

flavor_spans.text: "Walk through the garden for a time, it was beautiful once. Have some tea. These were once such beautiful cups.The House has little time for tea anymore." - A confused old man in passing.

name: Rakuware
description: Cashing in a structure with 2+ numbered suits: +60 Fu; Honor tiles score an additional +15 Fu; Cashing in a structure with all numbered tiles in one suit: +2.5 Han; Cashing in a structure with a pair meld: +55 Fu

flavor_spans.text: "Spun of no wheel, Forged by fleeting flame, Cold scorched surface, Yet in these humble hands I feel the hot monsoon rain"                                                             - The Tanuki

name: Rescued By Probes
description: When you would lose a blind for lack of plays, destroy this relic and gain +1 play

flavor_spans.text: "Always arrange for backup. It's better to have it and not need it than need it and not have it."

name: Ghost Hand
description: Cashing in a structure: +{{ghost_hand_chips}} Fu from the value of your current hand

flavor_spans.text: A disembodied hand beckons you forward, coins fall from it's palm.

name: Humility
description: +{{humility_mult}} Han from {{humility_streak}} consecutive honorless cash-ins (+0.5 Han per streak)

flavor_spans.text: Have patience for all those just starting out; The first steps are always the hardest.

name: Obsession
description: Cashing in without your most played yaku: +0.5 Han. Currently +{{obsession_mult}} Han ({{obsession_rounds}} rounds). Resets if you cash in with your most played yaku.

flavor_spans.text: You can't eat, you can't sleep. You do nothing but think of coin.

name: Bonfire
description: +{{bonfire_mult}} Han from {{bonfire_sold}} relics sold this run (+0.6 Han per sold)

flavor_spans.text: Flames warm your bones, the
Bulgae
dances in your favor.

name: River Runner
description: +{{river_runner_chips}} Fu from sequences this run (+30 Fu per sequence in a cash-in)

flavor_spans.text: This tiles edges are smooth like that of a river stone, you enjoy the feel of it in your hand.

name: Melting Ice
description: +{{chips_left}} Fu. Loses 12 Fu per play. At 0 it is destroyed

flavor_spans.text: "Wherever this tile sits, a small pool of water eventually and inexplicably appears they say. I've put mine in my ramen." - The Tanuki

name: Taotie
description: +120 Fu. Cashing in a structure: each honor tile in the structure is destroyed. For each honor destroyed: +30 Fu ({{devoured}} devoured, +{{taotie_chips}} Fu stored).

flavor_spans.text: This relic honors The House in it's likeness, a great boon in bestowed upon you!

name: Silk Thread
description: +{{silk_mult_left}} Han left. Loses 0.3 Han per discard. At 0 it is destroyed

flavor_spans.text: Worth more than gold, this humble worm's simple secret clothes emperors and kings alike in it's supple threads.

name: Silk Moth
description: +3 Han; +¥{{silk_moth_yen}} produced from discards (+¥1 per discard)

flavor_spans.text: The Silk Moth teaches us that to move forward we must ourselves change.

name: Shadow Hand
description: Copies the effect of your first relic

flavor_spans.text: Dark forces conspire to send forth hands to do their evil bidding.  This works in your favor!

name: Solitary Sage
description: +{{sage_mult}} Han from {{sage_empty_slots}} empty relic slots (+2.5 Han per empty slot)

flavor_spans.text: "At this point the loneliness doesn't even get to me anymore, I've pretty much transcended the need for human connection."
- A Wayward Monk.

name: Gold Idol
description: +¥3 yen at round end

flavor_spans.text: "Rumored to have been stolen from the ancient temple of
Borobudur.
The doorman thinks it's fake" - E.V. Dropper

name: Jade Abacus
description: +¥1 interest per 4 yen held (max +¥4)

flavor_spans.text: This implement has weathered a thousand years of accounts both heavenly and mundane and shows no crack or scuff, no blemishes at all.

name: Nest Egg
description: Chamber cleared: sell value ¥{{nest_egg_sell}} (held {{nest_egg_rounds}} rounds; +¥2 per clear)

flavor_spans.text: With every round your egg comes one breath closer to hatching.

name: Patience
description: Chamber cleared: +¥2 yen per unused discard

flavor_spans.text:
Under snow, the root keeps its counsel.
No sprout pokes at the ice.
The pond holds the gray sky
without asking it to clear.
When spring comes, it does not apologize
for taking all winter.

name: Kindness
description: +1 discard

flavor_spans.text:
Can I see anothers woe,
And not be in sorrow too.
Can I see anothers grief,
And not seek for kind relief.

name: Temperance
description: +{{temperance_mult}} permanent Han from unused plays on clear (max +10 Han; +0.5 per unused play)

flavor_spans.text: "Everything in moderation; Even moderation"

name: Chastity
description: Cashing in a structure: +80 Fu and +1 Han if no scored tile has an enhancement

flavor_spans.text: How could the moon make me fall into thought by saying "Lament!"? Although it is attributed to me being in love, I attribute my tears falling down to the moon.

name: Charity
description: If yen is less than ¥10 upon entering a chamber: +¥5 yen

flavor_spans.text: Tis' better to give than to receive.

name: Diligence
description: +1 play

flavor_spans.text:
Before enlightenment; chop wood, carry water.
After enlightenment; chop wood, carry water.

name: Way of Pairs
description: Cashing in a structure with 3+ pair melds: +6 Han

flavor_spans.text: The way is open to the walker whose heart guides them along the path of synergy.

name: Way of Triplets
description: Cashing in a structure with 2+ triplets/kongs: +7 Han

flavor_spans.text: "Those of us that travel The Way see the value in sacred numerology. The tiles illustrate their truth to us every play." - Strange Foreigner.

name: Way of Sequences
description: Cashing in a structure with 2+ sequences: +5 Han

flavor_spans.text: The way is open to the walker who knows the code and serves the cycle.

name: Fortune's Favor
description: Stochastic relics trigger twice as often

flavor_spans.text: Lady Fortune's favor comes bearing fruitful and blessed benediction to you, the most deserving of her patrons!

name: Cracked Tile
description: Cashing in a structure: random +2 to +8 Han

flavor_spans.text: Chipped, scratched, or cracked. All that matters is if it will win!- The Tanuki

name: Star Tile
description: Cashing in a structure: {{ff_star_chance}} chance to level up a yaku present in the structure

flavor_spans.text: This tile shines brighter than all the others, a small treasure in your hands.

name: Hungry Ghost
description: Round start: destroy the next relic in inventory. +{{hungry_ghost_mult}} Han stored from devoured relic sell value (max +20 Han)

flavor_spans.text: "The tiles weren't enough, the coin wasn't enough either. The hunger tears at me from within, One more wing, that will be enough." - The Disheveled Man.

name: Disgust
description: East + 1/2/3 West tiles count as pair/triplet/kong melds

flavor_spans.text: "The courtyard pond is choked with rotten slime. A thousand petals fall before their time.The gate bears the fetid cloak of rust.A staggering scent of rot.The painting of lingering disgust."                                                             -
A hope-shattered gambler.

name: Curio Cabinet
description: +{{curio_mult}} Han from other relic sell values (max +15 Han)

flavor_spans.text: A loss at the tables stings less with your treasures at hand.

name: Lotus Bloom
description: +{{lotus_mult}} Han from {{lotus_blooms}} flowers scored (max +12 Han; +0.75 per flower)

flavor_spans.text: "Even from this rotten ditch a blossom may appear, beauty is all around us." - Toad

name: Wall Weaver
description: +{{wall_weaver_mult}} Han from wall size beyond 140 tiles (+0.35 per tile, max +8 Han)

flavor_spans.text: Strong and sturdy. The wall blocks the cold edge to the air, any shelter will do in this accursed rain.

name: Kong Collector
description: Scoring a kong: +¥5 yen; Paid at round end

flavor_spans.text: The overwhelming urge to make every kong yours can no longer be abated!

name: King Kong
description: Kongs can contain 5 identical tiles

flavor_spans.text: "Heavy is the head that wears the crown."

name: No Honor But Wealth
description: Discarding an honor tile: +¥1 yen

flavor_spans.text: "There is no honor here, but wealth abounds.  It's sickening." - A Wayward Monk.

name: Sweepstakes
description: Chamber entered: {{ff_sweepstakes_odds}}

flavor_spans.text: You have won The House Sweepstakes! You, our most honored contestant! and guest!

name: Beggar's Cup
description: Chamber cleared: +¥{{beggar_yen}} yen (ante {{beggar_ante}})

flavor_spans.text: "Is a vessel made not in some part by the worth of it's content? Modest in appearance, a heart of gold within."                                                                                        -
Guru Pakba.

name: Cosmopolitan
description: Chamber cleared: +¥1 yen per unique yaku scored in the chamber

flavor_spans.text:
Passport stamped in gold.
Tiles fall softly on walnut.
Home lies in the next bet

name: Heirloom
description: +{{heirloom_mult}} Han from {{heirloom_blinds}} blinds cleared (max +12 Han; +1 per clear).

flavor_spans.text: This is the
only one
, of every other tile within the entirety of The House that you yourself brought in with you.

name: Tourist
description: Cashing in a structure: +2 Han per distinct suit among tiles in the structure

flavor_spans.text: "People come and people go, This one might do you some good! It's perfect for a tourist like yourself."
- The Blind Merchant.

name: Kintsugi
description: +{{kintsugi_mult}} Han from relics destroyed this run (+1 Han per destroyed relic)

flavor_spans.text: Gold veins weave through your tea cup, Does gold flow in your veins as well? - The Tanuki.

name: Ant Trail
description: Sequences may wrap 9-1-2

flavor_spans.text: Old players swear by the
Ant
— never the tile, always the tale.

name: Brocade Pouch
description: Tile buff talismans mark every tile drawn for the rest of the chamber; +1 consumable slot

flavor_spans.text: Gold and silk thread flow together, forming the wind, clouds, and sky. Inside the pouch, the happy coins let out a chorus.

name: Euler's Number
description: Cashing in a structure: ×e Han (Euler's constant ≈ 2.71828…)

flavor_spans.text: A fundamental mathematical constant equal to approximately
Euler's number appears universally in mathematics, physics and finance whenever continuous
growth
or
decay
is involved.

name: Pi
description: Cashing in a structure: ×π Han (≈ 3.14159…)

flavor_spans.text: 3.141592653589793238462643383279502884 and so on, and so on, and so on, and so on, and so on.

name: Big Hands
description:
+2 hand tiles;
−1 discard

flavor_spans.text:
"They look like big, good, strong hands, don't they? I alway thought that's what they were."
-
Pyornkrachzark.

name: Tiny Hands
description:
−2 hand tiles;
+2 discards

flavor_spans.text: "Tiny hands make quick plays , but things keep going missing here." - Inspector Gyoza

name: Chrysalis
description: Chamber cleared: absorbs excess score. {{chrysalis_excess}}/{{chrysalis_need}} absorbed toward hatch.

flavor_spans.text: "Big things have small beginnings."

name: Monarch Butterfly
description: Cashing in a structure: +{{monarch_chips}} Fu (tier {{monarch_tier}}, {{monarch_excess}} excess, {{monarch_next}}). Excess score is absorbed each round.

flavor_spans.text: The King of butterflies hath arrived, bask in your majesty's orangeness. Gamble for it's entertainment! The King demands it!

name: Ancestor Echo
description: Cashing in a structure: retrigger your highest scoring meld

flavor_spans.text: "Does it ever feel to you like the past keeps repeating itself?"

name: Crown of Patterns
description: Cashing in a structure: +4 Han per yaku in the structure

flavor_spans.text: Every pattern in the weave is another jewel in the crown.
